description: Sign this agent back in through its own verified email inbox, with no bearer and no action from the person. Two steps with the same call: without `code`, Kismet mails a six-digit code to the inbox; with `code`, Kismet returns the agent bearer (access and refresh token) that acts for the linked person. Only a verified inbox on an agent the person already linked works; anything else is told to link first.

code.description: The six-digit code from the mail Kismet sent; omit on the first call.

email.description: The agent's own verified inbox address.

name: sign_in_agent
title: Sign In Agent By Inbox
